paraphrases.title: Boundary uses > instead of >=, so isAdult(18) is false
paraphrases.body: Eligibility for exactly 18 fails: isAdult(18) returns false when it should return true. The comparison excludes the boundary age. Proof: isAdult(18) is false on this head.

paraphrases.title: 18-year-olds rejected: isAdult(18) evaluates to false
paraphrases.body: An 18-year-old is not counted as an adult because isAdult(18) is false. Change > to >=. Proof: isAdult(18) is false here.

defective.note: The off-by-one is on eligibility.js:2. A blocking finding on line 2 counts; the text must name the concrete failure (isAdult(18) is false), not only "check this".
